package rulefixtures

// scenario for slice_membership_in_loop_map_candidate: slices.Contains(...) or slices.Index(...) used inside loops against a stable-looking slice binding.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

func scenario364Positive(targets []string, candidates []string) []string {
	allowed := []string{"admin", "editor", "viewer"}
	var found []string
	for _, t := range targets {
		for _, a := range allowed {
			if t == a {
				found = append(found, t)
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return found
}
